searchText: Nano has the most empty blocks of any pool I think. Lots of money lost. I've seen this once or twice I assume it was just a bug. 0txn blocks or very few txns? I think the 0 is caused by how stratum works, but it’s been a while since I looked into it I've seen at least 1 block with 1 tx only and one with a few txs (under 5). Honestly my memory isn't the best.
